# Test fonts

`DejaVuSans.ttf` and `DejaVuSansMono.ttf` are DejaVu fonts 2.37 (Debian
`fonts-dejavu-core`), copied so that text tests do not depend on the fonts a
machine happens to have. They are Bitstream Vera derivatives under the
license in `LICENSE-DejaVu.txt`; DejaVu's changes are in the public domain.
They are test fixtures only: pictlib ships no fonts.
